text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during our all-out advance<n>toward the
Tokai Stakes, a group of<n>reporters enter the
academy grounds.<n>We're asked to go about our
days as<n>normal, however...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Is this the day I finally get<n>interviewed as
a full-fledged racer?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Hey, isn't that the "biter" that<n>broke news not
too long ago?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That's her all right! That incident was<n>a real
shocker... I wonder if she's got<n>any more crazy
stories to tell!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAWR!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: GAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What was that? She really is unruly...<n>Better jot that
down...
choice_data_list:
(Oh no... Windy's reputation is about to take
another hit!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put "Shinko Windy" into a search<n>engine, and sure
enough, the words<n>that pop up are "biter,"
"coward,"<n>"meme," among others...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing has changed... Not a single<n>article or
comment mentions how<n>strong she is on the track.
choice_data_list: Sigh... It's going to take a while for her reputation to rebound...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whatcha sighin' for?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You think I've never looked<n>up my own
name online?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeesh... Nobody gets it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'mma show 'em all what's what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's worked hard to get here,<n>believing that
running alone would<n>solve all her problems. But it
doesn't<n>seem like that's working out for her...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dang it... That's it! Gloves are comin'<n>off, right
now! Next race, I'mma crush<n>everyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C'mon! If I don't, how the heck can<n>I... Urgh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How else can I get people to forget<n>the biting
incident?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's probably right... An impressive<n>victory will get
more press than a<n>race incident. If she can do that...
then<n>her current reputation can be swept<n>under the
rug.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I'mma do whatever it takes,<n>got that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get some more training in,<n>even if I have
to do it by myself! Step<n>back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's already pushing herself too<n>hard as it is...
Nothing good can<n>happen from ramping up the pace
even further.
choice_data_list: (There has to be something I can do...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or is Windy on a tear<n>practicing on her
own these days?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's running wild all over<n>again... I just
hope she isn't<n>overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrr... Shut up! I can hear you!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Just you wait! I'll get so strong... you<n>won't dare
talk about me like that<n>anymore!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I'll make things change, even if it's<n>the last thing I
do!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
('Cause I've got ambition! And I'll<n>never give that
up!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRRAAAAAR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sloppily runs across the track in<n>her
desperation. What's worse, it<n>seems like she's
more conscious of<n>the surrounding Umamusume
than of<n>the track before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's too competitive, and it's<n>causing her to be
distracted. That<n>weakness can't be fixed overnight.
Then again... that fiery spirit is also<n>what gives her
an edge.
choice_data_list: (Maybe it can be used in a different way?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure I've read about atraining method for times like this.Something about field of vision...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, Biko! That's a new record!<n>Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All those little steps are adding up...<n>Well done,
dearie.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, I'm far from done! I must get<n>even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Back at summer camp... I made up<n>my mind not to
go out like this. I have<n>to end my losing streak!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrwwwaaarrr!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Windy's really going for it! Is<n>all that really
necessary, though? I<n>hope she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know that she's far stronger than<n>the world
believes her to be. There's<n>no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Instead, we should focus on our own<n>training. Time
for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has long struggled to<n>keep her focus
and control her fiery<n>spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After rummaging through papers, I<n>finally find the
training method I'm<n>hoping will help alleviate this
issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she takes well to it, she'll be able<n>to fixate on the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to talk? Make it quick,<n>then. I've got
strength training to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her bad mood, the<n>pressure seems to
be getting to her.<n>Maybe she's starting to sense
the<n>limits of her nonstop training...
choice_data_list: I've come up with a plan.
I've come up with a plan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oooh? One that'll make me stronger?<n>I'll spare you
a minute to speak.
choice_data_list: I'm going to give you a "switch."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Switch? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Shinko Windy is too busy<n>worrying about
what her rivals and<n>spectators think of her to
maintain<n>focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To solve this, I explain, we're going<n>to try creating a
"mental switch"<n>that'll help her narrow her vision to
see only what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I don't get it. Quit the metaphors and<n>give it to me
straight.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pull the blackout curtain from the<n>window and
quickly wrap it around<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's the big idea?!<n>Everything's gone black!
choice_data_list: Picture the track in your mind!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The track?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm...
choice_data_list:
Start running in place. Imagine you're in a race right
now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list:
Now for the important part—all you can see is the
track ahead. Everything else is dark.

Now for the important part—all you can see is the
track ahead. Everything else is dark.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Everything else... is dark...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No one... Nothing...
choice_data_list: The finish line shines like a beacon.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ohhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fweegh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let go of the curtain and a gale of<n>crisp evening
wind blows in, revealing<n>a calmed-down Shinko
Windy<n>underneath.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what just happened?
choice_data_list: I want you to repeat that when you're on the track!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So I gotta imagine that<n>everything's dark...
except for the<n>track in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Test run. Now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the training grounds, we find a<n>number of
Umamusume hard at work.<n>Shinko Windy joins
them, trying to<n>replicate what we've just practiced.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Um, let's see. I've got to imagine...<n>Right? Imagine...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Windy's acting weird again. Is this<n>some new
prank of hers?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Twitch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Exhale!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kicks off with a stony face and<n>hurtles along a
laser-guided path,<n>paying no mind to the looks and
comments around her!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way... She's completely changed<n>from this
morning!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pant...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Uh... yeah...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing... like... everything<n>around me went
blank!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I can use this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
From this point onward, I'mma call<n>this my
darkness switch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! That was a good call,<n>my diabolical
strategist!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The legend of Wicked Windy is... uh...<n>back in full
force!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This method definitely has potential! It<n>seems like it
worked for her, so if she<n>keeps using it, the positive
effects<n>may further improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This strategy could be our key to<n>winning the Tokai
Stakes!
